scenes.prompt: A tween-girl's bedroom homework desk corner, shot on a 35mm lens at seated-child eye-level slight three-quarter so the pink retro desk lamp anchors the back-left of a 1:1 frame on a slim white-painted writing desk. Late afternoon: warm window light rakes in from a sash window at frame-right with sheer cotton curtains pulled halfway, throwing soft golden bars across the desk. Style with a tilted open spiral notebook half-filled with handwriting, a yellow ticonderoga pencil resting in the spine, a chunky stack of three well-loved hardback novels stood vertical with a small ceramic horse figurine on top, a striped enamel mug of milk on a folded gingham coaster, and a small terracotta pot of trailing pothos at frame-right. Walls are a soft butter-yellow paint with a leaning small framed botanical sketch. The lamp matches the reference image exactly — glossy pink painted iron bell-shade with the black ribbed gooseneck arm and matching pink painted round base with rocker switch — switched ON, cool white 4500K (matches the bright white LED bulb clearly visible inside the variant reference). Palette of butter yellow, dusty pink, cream, pale oak, fresh green. Sharp focus, natural and photographic, no people, no cinematic moodiness.
